notebooks.lead: One notebook per subject. Open one to add sources and turn them into study material.
notebooks.name: Name
notebooks.deleteBody: Its sources and its flashcards go with it. This cannot be undone.
notebooks.unreachableBody: Your notebooks are safe — the app just can't load them right now. Make sure the backend is running, then try again.
notebooks.emptyBody: Start with one notebook per course or topic, then add your study files inside it.
notebooks.sourceRequiredBody: Select a document in Notebooks and generate {what} from that source. You cannot create them manually.
notebooks.fallbackNotice: The local AI model was unavailable, so these {kind} came from the basic fill-in-the-blank fallback (lower quality). Check that Ollama is running — "brew services start ollama" — then generate again.
notebooks.dragHere: Drag a file here or browse below
notebooks.removeBody: This deletes the file from this notebook. Generated flashcards and quizzes will remain.
notebooks.unsupportedFile: Unsupported file. Use PDF, Word (.docx), or PowerPoint (.pptx).
notebooks.addSourcesBody: Upload files, then check one or more sources to combine them for flashcards and quizzes.
notebooks.checkToGenerate: Check sources on the left, or open a ready file and generate.
notebooks.checkThisSource: Check this source (checkbox) to include it in generation.
notebooks.moreCharacters: … {count} more characters (generation reads the whole document)
notebooks.selectToGenerateFlashcards: Select at least one ready source (checkbox) to generate flashcards.
notebooks.selectToGenerateQuiz: Select at least one ready source (checkbox) to generate a quiz.
notebooks.replaceBody: The new cards start from scratch, and your review progress on the current ones is retired.
